title: The First Catalog
hint: Look on the small stand between the south door and the bookshelves.
description: The archive’s first catalog lists people’s names before it lists book titles. Beneath each name, it records who first remembered that person and where they sat to read the memory.
inscription: If you have forgotten a name, find the place where they sat.

title: The Night Roll Call
hint: The watch roll lies on the first reading desk in the west wing.
description: Each night a guard walked the walls and counted the lanterns. The total never changes in the register, but on the last three pages it takes a few more steps to walk from one lantern to the next.
inscription: If you see one lantern too many, turn back without counting it.

title: The Stargazer’s Journal
hint: Follow the curved rampart up from the plaza. Look on the western parapet of the round observatory.
description: The stargazer measured each night against the band of the galaxy beyond the walls. Then the little stars in the west began to vanish and return in the same order, though the band itself never changed. On the last page, the observer crossed the entry out of the weather column and left a line for it elsewhere.
inscription: What moved first in the place that stayed dark the longest?

title: The Bookbinder’s Repair Slip
hint: Enter the workshop west of the plaza and examine the workbench by the door.
description: Unpick the broken threads. Mend the tears with thin paper. At the foot of the slip is a promise to return the book before the last reading. The space for its title is blank, but the pen left its impression in the paper.
inscription: First ask who is waiting for the book.

title: Star Route Cargo Receipt
hint: Look on the book crate against the south wall at the back of the storehouse.
description: It took three people to lift a crate out of empty space. One wound the rope, one recorded the weight, and the last called out the titles of the books that had returned. The handwriting in the recipient’s box is always the same.
inscription: One crate, twenty-three volumes. The voices went uncounted.

title: On the Preservation of Black Ink
hint: Once inside the corridor, examine the stone wall opposite the mural.
description: Even held to a flame, the archive’s black ink never dries. When no one remembers the event on the page, the letters sink one by one into the black from which they came. This is why people gather in the reading hall to read the same sentence aloud.
inscription: What must endure is the person who remembers the ink.

title: The Unreturned Book
hint: Open the seal, then examine the wall between the original manuscripts on the west shelves.
description: One box in the return register has long stood empty. The journal says the borrower will come back one day. Each day someone dusted the shelf so that no one else would take the book’s place.
inscription: If you are still reading, leave the date blank.

title: A Map for the Homeward Journey
hint: Beyond the latch, examine the north wall of the passage leading to the main hall.
description: One line leads away from the archive. Three lead back. In the margins, the mapmaker recorded what they saw on the way home in place of the building’s dimensions. At the end of the shortest path stands a bookshelf anyone would recognize.
inscription: When you open the last door, choose the first book you remember.
